'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[September 2023 Jenin incursion]]
***Four [[Palestinians]] are killed and 30 others are injured in an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli Army]] raid in the [[Jenin refugee camp]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. Two other Palestinians were also killed both in [[Jericho]] and [[Khan Yunis]] that afternoon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/19/israel-kills-3-palestinians-in-gaza-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh]]
***Four [[Azerbaijanis|Azerbaijani]] police officers and two [[civilian]]s are killed by separate [[land mine|mine]] [[explosion]]s in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]], with [[Azerbaijan]] blaming [[Armenia]]n [[sabotage]] groups for the deaths. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/09/19/Six-killed-in-Karabakh-mine-blasts-Azerbaijan-says (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
***Azerbaijan launches an offensive on Nagorno-Karabakh, demanding the withdrawal of ethnic Armenian forces. Azerbaijani forces strike [[Stepanakert]], its de facto capital. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/9/19/nagorno-karabakh-live-azerbaijan-launches-new-anti-terror-operation (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/azerbaijan-armenia-nagorno-karabakh-1.6971115 (CBC News)]
***Azerbaijan claims that its forces broke through the [[Line of Contact (Nagorno-Karabakh)|contact line]] and captured over 60 military posts in Nagorno-Karabakh. Artsakh forces deny the claims. [https://www.reuters.com/world/azerbaijan-says-six-its-citizens-were-killed-by-land-mines-karabakh-2023-09-19/ (Reuters)]
***Artsakh says 25 people, including a child, were killed due to the fighting, and 138 others were injured. Azerbaijan says one civilian was killed by shelling in [[Shusha]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nagorno-karabakh-armenia-azerbaijan-mines-deaths-477fd82368be90f88163e50a5fcb6353/ (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Nine people are killed in [[Russia]]n attacks across [[Ukraine]], including six civilians in [[Kupiansk]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-air-assault-ukraines-western-city-lviv-ukraines-officials-2023-09-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[CNN]], citing a source in the Ukrainian military, reports that [[Special forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian special forces]] were likely behind recent [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] and a ground operation against [[Wagner Group]] mercenaries in [[Sudan]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/19/africa/ukraine-military-sudan-wagner-cmd-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Institut Européen d'Archéologie Sous-Marine]] announces the discovery of the site of a temple to the god [[Amun]] and a Greek sanctuary devoted to [[Aphrodite]] in [[Heracleion|Thonis-Heracleion]] in the [[Abu Qir Bay]] in [[Egypt]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/egypt-sunken-temple-discoveries/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed and eight others are injured by two [[tornado]]es in [[Yancheng]] and [[Suqian]] in [[Jiangsu]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-says-more-harsh-weather-store-after-tornado-kills-one-2023-09-20/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed when a military plane [[plane crash|crashes]] in [[Lamu County]], [[Kenya]], near the border with [[Somalia]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/09/19/at-least-8-dead-in-military-helicopter-crash-in-kenya/ (AFP via Africanews)]
*Two people are killed and nine others are seriously injured when a [[bus plunge]]s into a ravine near [[Cetinje]], [[Montenegro]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/montenegro-briton-among-at-least-two-dead-after-bus-plunges-into-ravine-12965166 (Sky News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022–2023 mpox outbreak]]
**[[Laos]] reports its first case of [[mpox]]. The national [[Ministry of Health (Laos)|health ministry]] recommends that provincial health departments set up laboratory facilities for screening tests. [https://english.news.cn/20230920/a713a7753e004299987a97f08b1a3e76/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Seventy-eighth session of the United Nations General Assembly]]
**The [[General debate of the seventy-eighth session of the United Nations General Assembly|general debate of the United Nations General Assembly]] opens at the [[Headquarters of the United Nations|UN Headquarters]] in [[New York City]], [[United States]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2023/sep/19/russia-ukraine-war-news-zelensky-united-nations-speech-biden-live-updates (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Southeast Asia]]n bloc [[ASEAN]] holds its first-ever joint [[military exercise]] in [[Indonesia]]. The five-day drills focus on humanitarian assistance and disaster relief. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2023/09/1d0c6fc73e88-asean-holds-first-ever-joint-military-exercises-in-indonesia.html (Kyodo News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Polish parliamentary election]]
**[[Cash-for-visa scandal]]
***Documents allegedly from the [[Poland|Polish]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Poland)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] indicate that the [[List_of_diplomatic_missions_of_Poland#Europe|Polish embassy]] in [[Minsk]], [[Belarus]], issued 784,173 visas to individuals from 65 countries with the aid of a [[Moscow]]-based company. Individuals who were denied entry at the Belarus-European Union border during the [[Belarus–European Union border crisis]] may also have been granted visas. [https://www.msn.com/pl-pl/wiadomosci/polska/polska-ambasada-na-bia%C5%82orusi-hojnie-wydawa%C5%82a-wizy-dostali-je-obywatele-65-kraj%C3%B3w-poprzez-firm%C4%99-z-rosji/ar-AA1gXcqw?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=95413962521a4003bea1a7975f41c066&ei=6&rc=1 (''Gazeta.pl'' via MSN News)]
*[[Derna dam collapses]]
**Protesters [[arson|burn down]] the house of mayor of [[Derna, Libya|Derna]] [[Abdulmenam Al-Ghaithi]] in response to the [[Storm Daniel|catastrophic floods]]. [[Internet]] and telephone access are subsequently shut down and foreign journalists are ordered to leave the city. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-66849131 (BBC News)]
*[[Extrajudicial killings and forced disappearances in the Philippines]]
**Two [[Environmental movement|environmental activist]]s, who [[Enforced disappearance|disappeared]] on September 2, are released in the [[Philippines]] and publicly accuse the [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|military]] of their abduction. The authorities have denied these allegations. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/21/two-activists-freed-in-philippines-after-being-abducted-by-the-military (AFP via Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**The [[Lahaina Banyan Tree]] in [[Hawaii]], United States, shows signs of new growth a month after being damaged by [[wildfire]]s. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2023/09/19/lahaina-banyan-tree-new-leaves-maui-wildfires/ (''The Washington Post'')]
